name: Cloudusk Captcha
author: cloudusk

sections.description:
Cloudusk CAPTCHA provides flexible, secure CAPTCHA protection for your WordPress site. Choose between Google reCAPTCHA v2, hCaptcha, or Cloudflare Turnstile and enable protection for the login page and/or comment forms.
It supports multiple providers and a modern React-based admin UI, enabling site owners to protect authentication and comment surfaces with minimal setup.

Features

  • Multi-provider support: reCAPTCHA v2, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile
  • Protect login and comment forms (configurable)

CAPTCHA Providers and Policies

Cloudusk CAPTCHA supports the following third-party CAPTCHA providers:

  • Google reCAPTCHA v2
    ** Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    ** Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • hCaptcha
    ** Terms of Service: https://www.hcaptcha.com/terms
    ** Privacy Policy: https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy

  • Cloudflare Turnstile
    ** Terms of Service: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/
    ** Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
